workspacePath.description: Forward-slash path relative to the workspace root.

startLine.description: One-based first line of the related code region.

endLine.description: One-based inclusive last line of the related code region. Must not precede startLine.

startColumn.description: Optional one-based first column. Must be provided with endColumn.

endColumn.description: Optional one-based exclusive end column. Must be provided with startColumn and exceed it for a single-line region.

base.description: Full Git commit SHA for the previous source snapshot.

head.description: Full Git commit SHA for the current source snapshot. The checked-out file must match it.

oldPath.description: Previous workspace-relative path when the file was renamed.

source.description: Source file containing the function definition.

symbol.description: Function or method name as shown by the editor outline.

animation.description: viscript Lua scene at .vscode/vis/<series>/animations/<scene>.lua. The series directory must equal the series field.

series.description: Required series name and directory. Visualizations with the same value appear as one ordered Preview series.

description.description: Markdown rendered below the Preview player.

line.description: Optional one-based definition line, useful for overloads.

range.description: Optional explicit code region used for source context and highlighting.

diff.description: Optional verified Git comparison. range always addresses the head/current file.
